initial_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution contains a fault because the stipulated top-level corpus includes qualifying record n06-r06 with demand_score 5, but the handoff consumed by Job 2 contains only seven needs and omits n06-r06. The downstream job appears to preserve and rank the records it received, so the omission is upstream. The supplied upstream code localizes the omission to normalize: its allowed_record_ids list excludes n06-r06 and includes n06-r09 instead, causing n06-r06 to be filtered out before the needs and evidence_sources handoff.
